elements.name: slide-subtitle
elements.text: Proposed access rules for confirmation. The cooperative decides who can see and edit each record.

Participant	Can view	Can manage
Administrator	All ecosystem records	Users, farms, produce, corrections and publication
Grower or farm team	Permitted batch history	Assigned growing and harvest records
Processor	Permitted origin and harvest records	Assigned processing, lot links and recipients
Brand owner or distributor	Permitted history of assigned batches	Assigned acknowledgement and own partner details
Consumer	Published profiles and batch summaries	None. Public viewing only
